samples.summary: No test covers renderLoopStatus with an absent maxRounds/failedRounds — Number(null) is 0, so the "Fix rounds used" line renders "N of 0"
samples.evidence: renderLoopStatus defaults `failedRounds = null, maxRounds = null` and gates the line on `Number.isFinite(Number(failedRounds)) && Number.isFinite(Number(maxRounds))`. `Number(null) === 0` is finite, so a call with no `--max-rounds` renders "**Fix rounds used:** 2 of 0". The agent-iterate-ci.yml call sites (`Update loop status (CI attempts exhausted)`, `Update loop status (CI-fix outcome)`) pass no `--max-rounds`, so this is the live path. loop-status.test.mjs only ever passes both values ("body starts with the marker…" uses failedRounds: 1, maxRounds: 3); every other render test omits both and asserts nothing about the line, so the suite is green either way. Notably the sibling guard-verdict.mjs explicitly guards this exact null-vs-zero hazard (`const n = ...`) AND tests it ("page summary tolerates the early paths" asserts !md.includes("null") and no confident "0 of 3"), while the same hazard in loop-status.mjs is untested.
searchedFor: grep for 'Fix rounds used' assertions in the test file
grep for max-rounds in the three modified workflow files

samples.summary: Test named "note is flattened to one line and bounded" never asserts the bound
samples.evidence: The test passes note "line1\nline2" and asserts only `/\*\*Latest:\*\* line1 line2/` — the `.slice(0, 600)` truncation in renderLoopStatus (loop-status.mjs:202) is never exercised. A note longer than 600 chars, or removal of the slice entirely, would leave this test green while the test name claims the bound is covered. Same untested truncation exists for guard-verdict.mjs's `String(v.detail).slice(0, 600)`.

samples.summary: The "Then" column's newest-round branches (paged / promoted / fixer running / fix pushed) are never rendered by any test
samples.evidence: renderLoopStatus's `then` value is a 5-way nested ternary over paged/ready/event. The two tests that set `paged: true` and `ready: true` ("a trusted paged latch beats the event headline", "ready (non-draft) beats the event headline") both pass `rounds: []`, so the table block at loop-status.mjs:207-236 does not execute at all — only the headline is asserted. The tests that do render a table ("body starts with the marker…", the MAX_ROUND_ROWS truncation test) use event "panel"/none, hitting only the "…" fallback. So "🛑 paged", "🤝 promoted", "🔧 fixer running…" and "🔧 fix pushed" cells — the per-round outcome this feature exists to show — have zero coverage.
searchedFor: grepped the test file for 'fixer running', 'promoted', '🛑 paged' cell assertions

samples.summary: The rendered "Agent effort so far" block is untested; summarizeEffort is only tested in isolation
samples.evidence: summarizeEffort has a unit test ("effort totals sum by kind and overall"), but no renderLoopStatus test passes an `effort` object, so the block at loop-status.mjs:238-246 — including the `byKind` Map iteration, the `formatUsd`/`formatMinutes` formatting and the `effort.sessions > 0` gate — never runs. A wrong shape (e.g. byKind as a plain object rather than a Map) would throw at runtime in CI with no test failing.
searchedFor: read loop-status.test.mjs for any `effort:` argument to renderLoopStatus
grepped for 'Agent effort so far' in scripts/agent/*.test.mjs

samples.summary: session-job-summary's actual wiring (read execution log → parseExecution → last result → classifyFixResult) has no test; only the pure renderer is tested with hand-built objects
samples.evidence: session-job-summary.test.mjs exercises renderSessionSummary with literal `rec`/`outcome` objects. main() is not exported and no test spawns the script, so the parts most likely to break — `JSON.parse(readFileSync(flags.execution))`, `[...messages].reverse().find(m => m.type === 'result')`, the `parseExecution(messages, kind)` call with kind values "implement"/"ci-fix"/"review-fix", and the documented "missing or unreadable execution log renders a line saying so" behaviour (which is only tested by passing rec: null directly, never by pointing at a nonexistent file) — are uncovered. Other scripts in this directory do spawn their CLIs in tests (e.g. novelty.test.mjs, command.test.mjs use child_process), so the convention exists.
searchedFor: grep for session-job-summary in other test files

samples.summary: panel-job-summary's cost/SDK-call aggregation from review-execution.json is untested
samples.evidence: panel-job-summary.test.mjs only calls renderPanelJobSummary with pre-computed `totalCostUsd: 9.87, sdkCalls: 14`. The main() logic that derives them — filtering `m.type === 'result'` out of review-execution.json and summing `total_cost_usd` — plus readJson's swallow-and-return-null behaviour for each of panel.json / review-lens-stats.json / review-timing.json, has no test and main() is not exported.

samples.summary: The guard's new verdict wiring (pagedRoundContext + setOutput("verdict")) has no test; guard-verdict.mjs is tested only as a pure renderer
samples.evidence: guard-verdict.test.mjs covers guardVerdictLine/renderGuardSummary against hand-built verdict objects, but nothing tests that review-round-guard.mjs passes the right objects: that `pagedRoundContext.failedRounds` is still null on the infra/invalid-verdict paths and populated on the standstill/stall/round-cap paths, that each page() call now supplies the matching `reason` tag, or that `verdict` is emitted on every branch including latched and proceed. There is no review-round-guard.test.mjs at all (glob scripts/agent/review-round-guard* returns only the .mjs), so a mismatched reason tag or a verdict output never set would ship green — and the round-guard workflow step consumes `steps.guard.outputs.verdict` directly as the sticky comment's note.

samples.summary: Uncovered display branches: lensCell's neutral fallback and panel-job-summary's null-entry verdict cell
samples.evidence: lensCell's final `➖ N ✅ / M neutral` return (loop-status.mjs:129) — the case where lenses completed with a conclusion that is neither success nor failure (skipped/neutral) — has no test; the three assertions in "lens cell names failing lenses and counts the rest" cover only failure, all-success and pending. Likewise panel-job-summary's `verdictCell(undefined) → "❌ missing (fails closed)"` branch is never hit: every test entry in panel-job-summary.test.mjs has a conclusion.

verdict.reason: Verified independently. renderLoopStatus (loop-status.mjs:176-201) defaults failedRounds/maxRounds to null and gates the "Fix rounds used" line on Number.isFinite(Number(x)); Number(null)===0 is finite, so an absent --max-rounds renders "N of 0". The CLI maps a missing flag to null (loop-status.mjs:335), and agent-iterate-ci.yml:192-194 and :396-397 invoke the script with no --max-rounds, making that the live path. In loop-status.test.mjs (read in full) the only assertion touching the line is L128 with failedRounds:1/maxRounds:3; the other render tests (L136-158) omit both fields and assert nothing about the line's presence or absence, so the false branch of the gate is never exercised and the suite passes either way. Repo-wide greps for "loop-status", "Fix rounds", and "of 0" turned up no other test importing renderLoopStatus, no snapshot/dry-run integration test, and no .trusted/ counterpart test. No counterexample exists.
